answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the pearl graph and each risks its bond. Because the quill release is logged with every signature, the river audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
